description: This file defines multiple React UI components for rendering 'empty' state screens, such as placeholders when no data is available. Components include layout wrappers, media, title, description, header, and content sections, all stylized and composable.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: A React component that provides a styled container for empty state content, forwarding ref and accepting additional props.

methods.name: EmptyHeader
methods.description: A React component for rendering a header section within the empty state, styled and centered.

methods.name: EmptyMedia
methods.description: A React component to display media (like icons or images) with different style variants based on the 'variant' prop.

methods.name: EmptyTitle
methods.description: A styled header component for the title of the empty state.

methods.name: EmptyDescription
methods.description: A paragraph component for displaying descriptive text in the empty state.

methods.name: EmptyContent
methods.description: A container component for flexible layout of content within the empty state, supporting row or column layout.
